title: Lace Blouse over Velvet Corset
prompt: An original young woman with blonde hair pulled back into loose strands wears a sheer dark lace high-neck blouse with long sleeves, layered over a dark velvet corset with metal grommets and a central lace-up front. Layered chain necklaces with a round pendant sit at her throat. Her expression is calm and serious. Soft, diffused forest light with blurred green foliage and fallen leaves. Palette of deep violet, forest green, and muted gold. Dark romantic and earthy, in the style of a moody forest editorial.
workingNotes:
- The lace sleeves over the corset are the defining layers.
- Keep the blurred forest for a soft, dreamy depth.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the blurred forest for soft depth.
